recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Do not reopen FHIR-12387 unless Pharmacy or Workflow decides to supersede FHIR-14022 or add a new current MedicationAdministration-specific workflow definition relationship.
issue_request: FHIR-12387 was a Published Pharmacy change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2, asking to harmonize MedicationAdministration with the Workflow Event logical model. The approved resolution requested a definition/protocol link to ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition, partOf references to MedicationAdministration and Procedure, the unknown status code, Group as a subject target, a context element for Encounter or EpisodeOfCare, and a performer backbone with role/function and actor details.
initial_application: Jira comments say the spreadsheet changes were applied on 2017-01-14. Git commit 7003eba639b96a6cb1198300f293effe3f4bda1d is the matching source application: it updated the then-authoritative MedicationAdministration spreadsheet and examples with definition, partOf, unknown status, subject Reference(Patient|Group), context Reference(Encounter|EpisodeOfCare), and a repeating performer backbone. Follow-up commit 6aceb453fc5da56a92144d6de12c118e3b891ef0 corrected the initial onBehalfOf placement for FHIR-12631.
additional_context: Later final Pharmacy/workflow decisions reshaped the same area. FHIR-14022, applied in commit b22fbdaff11417e468a75c0657ffec6170e99c1f and already audited on the combined branch, realigned MedicationAdministration to the updated Workflow Event pattern by replacing definition with instantiates, adding not-done/statusReason/performer.function, and removing performer.onBehalfOf. Current workflow guidance says prior generic instantiatesCanonical/instantiatesUri elements were replaced by more specific workflow relationship extensions, now maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack. MedicationAdministration remains active in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source already contains the active, current-spec semantics needed for this issue: partOf includes MedicationAdministration and Procedure, status includes unknown, subject allows Group, performer is a backbone with function and actor, and the resource carries Workflow Event mappings with documented Event mapping exceptions. Restoring the old definition/context/onBehalfOf shape would conflict with later applied workflow alignment and current extension guidance.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the onBehalfOf placement introduced during the FHIR-12387 application; already represented on the combined branch.

Later aligned MedicationAdministration to the updated Workflow Event pattern and explains the current absence of the old definition and performer.onBehalfOf shape; already represented on the combined branch.
